title: 육군공병학교령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Commandant)
(1) The Army Engineer School shall have one Commandant.
(2) The Commandant shall be appointed from among general officers of the Army or civilian military officials of Grade II or higher. <Amended on Sep. 2, 2025>
(3) The Commandant shall, under the direction of the Chief of Staff of the Army, exercise overall supervision of the affairs of the School and command and supervise its subordinate departments and units. <Amended on Nov. 14, 2017>
(4) Deleted. <Nov. 14, 2017>
